name: 33 Seaport Hotel New York
positioning: Intimate hotel, officially named 33 Hotel, New York City, Seaport, in a landmarked red-brick building on the cobbled streets of Manhattan's historic South Street Seaport, with Brooklyn Bridge and East River views
best_for: Travelers who want a quieter downtown Manhattan base by the Brooklyn Bridge
Couples who want a terrace suite with Brooklyn Bridge and East River views

facts.text: The hotel sits amid the cobbled streets of Downtown Manhattan's historic South Street Seaport.
The hotel is surrounded by views of the East River, the Brooklyn Bridge and the New York City skyline.
The hotel is housed in a landmarked red-brick building at 33 Peck Slip that blends with the Seaport District's Georgian and Federal-style architecture.
Rooms have teak veneer finishes, rainfall showers, plush linens and 50-inch interactive 4K televisions.
Rooms and suites have marble bathrooms.
The Brooklyn Bridge Grand Terrace Suite has two full-sized white marble bathrooms and a separate living room.
Pier 17 and the Brooklyn Bridge are a short walk from the hotel.
Bellhops welcome guests and share the inside scoop on New York City.
Pets are welcome for a small fee, with a maximum of two pets.
ADA rooms have accessibility features including roll-in showers, widened doorways and lowered sinks.
Urban Cove Society & Kitchen serves Modern American cuisine with global influences.
Urban Cove Society & Kitchen faces cobblestone-lined Peck Slip and has a dining room, bar and seasonal outdoor patio.

highlights.text: The Brooklyn Bridge Suite Terrace has a furnished wraparound terrace with views of Lower Manhattan, the Brooklyn Bridge and the East River.
Select accommodations have private terraces overlooking the East River, the Brooklyn Bridge and the Lower Manhattan skyline.
Loft rooms have an arched window with views of the Brooklyn Bridge.
Guests get exclusive offers from neighborhood partners, including sailing excursions with Manhattan By Sail and classes at Seaport Pilates.

considerations.text: The hotel has no spa, but it has a gym.
The nearest subway is about a 10-minute walk away.
Self-parking is available at a neighboring garage.
